concepts.angle: The sport is won in the boring middle, not in the hard sessions people post about.
concepts.hook: the boring part is the sport
concepts.coverImageIntent: runner full body white background studio

slides.text: everyone can do the hard session. almost nobody does the easy one properly.
slides.imageIntent: woman running outdoors daylight full body

slides.text: your easy run should feel insulting. that is what makes the hard one possible.
sleep is a session. miss it and you did not train, you just got tired.
take the down week before you need it, not after.
five years of patient beats one year of heroic, every time.

concepts.closerKicker: we post one of these a week

concepts.angle: People buy intensity because it feels like progress. Consistency feels like nothing and does everything.

slides.text: adding a session to a body that has not recovered is not training. it is debt.
the plan you can repeat in february beats the one you abandon in january.
slides.imageIntent: runner full body white background studio

slides.text: if every run hurts, none of them are doing what they are for.
measure the week, not the session.

concepts.cta: save this before your next block
concepts.closerImageIntent: muscular man portrait plain background daylight

concepts.angle: A concrete two-line comparison does the arguing better than a paragraph.

slides.text: six hard days, no sleep, one injury. that is a season lost in march.
four steady days, eight hours, no injuries. that is a season.
slides.imageIntent: woman running outdoors daylight full body

slides.text: the second athlete trained fewer hours and finished more races.
the difference was never effort. it was what happened between sessions.
